test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ENTRUST' is coded as 'FOURVTU' and 'CUSHION' is coded as 'DVTHJPO'. What is the code for 'CLEAVER' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'ENTRUST' is coded as 'FOURVTU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6104c06e85b0c888e8ac56a52f656bb3c65fab5d7f64eaaaaa287876efc5adad.png] 

And, 

 
• 'CUSHION' is coded as 'DVTHJPO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf9c62ffc44cc7480a7c9741366d526005e632a3a42543a17a6c2a04539df28d.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'CLEAVER' is coded as:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e12ff639ef8ab6842c095f0290db8a09bd3d638248ea3334faa68ce7ab6450b9.png] 

Hence, "**DMFAWFS**" is the correct answer.
